mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO pisces_experiment_exposure (exposure_id, experiment_id, visitor_id, group_id, scene, properties_json, idempotency_key, exposed_at) VALUES (#{entity.exposureId}, #{entity.experimentId}, #{entity.visitorId}, #{entity.groupId}, #{entity.scene}, #{entity.propertiesJson}, #{entity.idempotencyKey}, #{entity.exposedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, exposure_id, experiment_id, visitor_id, group_id, scene, properties_json, idempotency_key, exposed_at, created_at FROM pisces_experiment_exposure WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
